prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1277; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the right-hand lane of a Baytown, Texas roadway when Driver 2 moved left into the same space without signaling and struck the side of Driver 1's vehicle. Both vehicles remained on scene and the contact left a clear pattern of scraping and crushed panels along the driver's side of Driver 1's car, consistent with the sideswipe described by both drivers. Driver 2 acknowledged changing lanes and did not dispute how the collision occurred. Two independent witnesses in a nearby vehicle gave statements that matched the account, and photographs taken at the scene show the damage in the same location and direction both drivers reported. Officers confirmed Passenger was seated in the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which fits the force of a side impact against the door and lower dash area. No prior damage to the vehicle was noted during the inspection, and Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
